newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach agrees sale of 14.6 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach agrees sale of 14.6 pct of shares.

text.p: Broker UBS Ltd said on Tuesday that former shareholders of Porterbrook planned to sell up to 35 million ordinary shares in Stagecoach representing 14.6 percent of Stagecoach's issued ordinary share capital.
It said in a statement that the shares would be placed with institutions following an Accelerated Global Tender by UBS.
Former Porterbrook shareholders acquired their interests in Stagecoach following the transport group's acquisition of the Porterbrook Leasing Co last year.
Stagecoach has agreed the early disposal of these shares which have been subject to selling restrictions under the terms agreed for the acquisition of Porterbrook.
Former Porterbrook shareholders include funds managed by Charterhouse Development Capital Ltd and its associated co-investors.
